data.long_description:
Experience elevated living in this exceptional high-floor apartment at Golf Grand, Dubai Hills Estate. Offering breathtaking skyline views and stunning Burj Al Arab views, this premium residence is ideal for those seeking comfort, luxury, and a vibrant lifestyle.

Spanning 1,073.38 sq. ft., this beautifully designed 2-bedroom apartment features bright and spacious interiors, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a modern layout that maximizes natural light and showcases the spectacular views. Ready to move in, this unfurnished home gives tenants the freedom to create a space that reflects their own style.

Property Features:

• 2 Bedrooms
• 2 Bathrooms
• 1,073.38 Sq. Ft.
• High Floor
• Skyline View
• Burj Al Arab View
• Ready to Move In
• Unfurnished
• Spacious Living & Dining Area
• Floor-to-Ceiling Windows

Community Amenities:

• Infinity Pool with Cabanas
• Fully Equipped Gymnasium
• Rooftop Lounge
• Landscaped Podium Deck
• BBQ Area
• Children's Play Area
• Multipurpose Room

Located in the heart of Dubai Hills Estate, residents enjoy easy access to Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Hills Golf Club, Dubai Hills Park, top schools, healthcare facilities, and major road networks connecting to Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina.

A rare rental opportunity to enjoy luxury living, world-class amenities, and iconic views in one of Dubai's most prestigious communities.
